text:
```yaml
name: Auto Approve Copilot PRs

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  auto-approve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install hmarr/auto-approve-action@v3
      
      - name: Check if PR is from Copilot
        id: copilot_check
        run: echo "::set-output name=from_copilot::$(gh pr view ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --json authorAssociation | jq -r '.authorAssociation == "SponsoredByGitHub"')"
      
      - name: Auto approve PR
        if: steps.copilot_check.outputs.from_copilot == 'true'
        uses: hmarr/auto-approve-action@v3
```
